title: quantum neural chips breakthrough
summary: Researchers announce room-temperature 1000-qubit optical neural processors.

blocks.content: A monumental leap in artificial intelligence computing hardware was unveiled today. Researchers have achieved room-temperature 1000-qubit optical neural processing.
This technological shift enables ultra-low power real-time AI execution on personal local devices without cloud latency.
